title: Uko Wakuramo Videwo za TikTok Nta Kirango (Ku Buntu, Nta App)
description: Amabwiriza yuzuye yo gukuramo videwo za TikTok nta kirango kuri telefoni na mudasobwa. Ni ubuntu, nta app, nta kwinjira. Koporora link, uyomeke, ukuremo.
body:
Urashaka kubika videwo za TikTok ukunda ariko udashaka ko ikirango n'izina rya konti biguma ku ishusho? Ushobora gukuramo videwo za TikTok nta kirango mu buryo bworoshye cyane: koporora link ya videwo, uyomeke kuri I Need Save, hanyuma uhitemo ubwiza wifuza. Nta yindi app ugomba gushyiramo, nta kwinjira bisabwa, kandi ni ubuntu.

Muri iyi mfashanyigisho uriga intambwe zose, uko wahitamo amahitamo akwiye, n'icyo wakora niba videwo itaragaragara muri Gallery.

Kuki Wahitamo Videwo za TikTok Zidafite Ikirango?

Iyo ubitse videwo ukoresheje buto ya TikTok ubwayo, akenshi iza ifite ikirango: ikirango cya TikTok n'izina ry'ukoresha. Niba ari iyo kwirebera wenyine bishobora kutaba ikibazo, ariko ikirango gishobora gupfuka igice cy'ingenzi cya videwo, nk'inyandiko y'uburyo bwo guteka, intambwe z'isomo, cyangwa amagambo y'indirimbo.

Verisiyo idafite ikirango iba isukuye kandi ishimishije kongera kureba. Ni yo mpamvu I Need Save ishyira imbere verisiyo idafite ikirango iyo ihari kuri videwo wometse.

Uko Wakuramo Videwo za TikTok Nta Kirango kuri Telefoni

Izi ntambwe ushobora kuzikora kuri Android no kuri iPhone. Reba neza ko videwo ituruka kuri konti rusange.

  1. Fungura app ya TikTok maze ushake videwo ushaka kubika.
  2. Kanda buto ya Sangiza (Share) kuri iyo videwo.
  3. Hitamo Koporora link (Copy link). Link ubu iri mu bubiko bw'ibyo wakoporoye.
  4. Fungura mushakisha (browser), ujye kuri ineedsave.com.
  5. Omeka link mu gasanduku kabugenewe, cyangwa ukande gusa buto ya Omeka.
  6. Kanda Kuramo maze utegereze gato kugeza amahitamo agaragaye.
  7. Hitamo videwo wifuza. Dosiye irahita ijya ku gikoresho cyawe.

Niba buto ihindutse ikandikaho Birimo gutegurwa…, ntugire impungenge. Videwo zimwe zibanza gutunganywa, urugero guhuza amashusho n'amajwi. Gukuramo biratangira ubwabyo dosiye imaze kuba yiteguye.

Uko Wakuramo kuri Mudasobwa

Uburyo ni bumwe hafi ya byose. Fungura TikTok muri mushakisha ya mudasobwa, hitamo videwo ushaka, hanyuma ukoporore link yayo ukoresheje menu ya Sangiza cyangwa aho bandika aderesi. Nyuma yaho fungura urupapuro rwo gukuramo, womeke link, ukande Kuramo, maze uhitemo ubwiza. Dosiye izajya mu bubiko bwa Downloads kuri mudasobwa yawe.

Gusobanukirwa Amahitamo Agaragara

Numara gukanda Kuramo, urabona amahitamo menshi. Dore ibisobanuro bigufi:

  • Videwo mu bwiza butandukanye, urugero 360p, 720p cyangwa 1080p, bitewe na videwo y'umwimerere. Uko umubare uri hejuru, ni ko ishusho irushaho kugaragara neza, ariko n'ingano ya dosiye ikiyongera.
  • Ikirango: amahitamo agifite ikirango yanditseho iri jambo. Niba ushaka videwo isukuye, hitamo videwo itanditseho Ikirango.
  • Amajwi: ushobora gukuramo ijwi gusa, haba mu bwiza bw'umwimerere cyangwa MP3 ya 192 kbps ihinduwe ivuye muri videwo.
  • Ifoto / Ifoto ntoya: ishusho y'igifuniko cya videwo.

Ntuzi ubwiza wahitamo? Soma kandi itandukaniro ry'ubwiza bwa videwo 360p, 720p na 1080p kugira ngo uhitemo ukurikije ecran yawe n'umwanya usigaye kuri telefoni.

Inama: Videwo zimwe za TikTok zikoresha codec ya HEVC (H.265). Telefoni zishaje cyane rimwe na rimwe ntizizikina neza. Niba hari ihitamo rya H.264, rifate kuko rikina ku bikoresho byose.

Videwo Wakuyemo Iri He?

Aho dosiye iri biterwa n'igikoresho ukoresha:

  • Android: videwo ibikwa mu bubiko bwa Downloads. App ya Gallery rimwe na rimwe ifata akanya gato mbere yo kuyigaragaza.
  • iPhone/iPad (Safari): videwo ijya muri app ya Files, mu bubiko bwa Downloads. Kugira ngo igaragare muri app ya Photos, fungura videwo muri Files, ukande Share, hanyuma uhitemo Save Video.

Dosiye za MP4 ukuyemo zifite igihe nyacyo kandi zikina muri Gallery nk'izindi videwo zisanzwe. Ikindi ukwiye kumenya: dosiye iva kuri TikTok ijya ako kanya ku gikoresho cyawe, ntibikwa kuri seriveri ya I Need Save.

Kuki Videwo Yanze Kuvamo?

Hari impamvu zimwe zituma videwo idashobora gukurwamo:

  • Videwo ituruka kuri konti yihariye.
  • Ibikubiyemo bishobora kurebwa gusa nyuma yo kwinjira.
  • Videwo yabujijwe mu turere tumwe.
  • Link wometse ntiyuzuye cyangwa yakoporowe nabi.

Ku mpamvu ya nyuma, ongera ukoporore link uyikuye kuri buto ya Sangiza, hanyuma utangire bundi bushya.

Bikoreshe Neza

Kuramo videwo zo gukoresha ku giti cyawe gusa. Ubaha uburenganzira bw'abahanzi: banza usabe uruhushya mbere yo kongera kuyishyira ku rubuga, kandi buri gihe uvuge izina rya nyirayo. Bityo uzakomeza kwishimira ibikubiyemo ukunda utabangamiye ababikoze.

Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa

Ese I Need Save ni ubuntu?

Yego, ni ubuntu. Nta n'ubwo ukeneye gushyiramo app cyangwa gufungura konti. Fungura gusa urubuga muri mushakisha yawe.

Ese videwo zose za TikTok ziboneka nta kirango?

Verisiyo idafite ikirango ihora ishyirwa imbere iyo ihari. Niba kuri videwo runaka hagaragaye gusa amahitamo yanditseho Ikirango, ushobora gukomeza ukuramo iyo verisiyo.

Nshobora gukuramo ijwi gusa?

Yego. Hitamo Amajwi, haba mu bwiza bw'umwimerere cyangwa MP3 ya 192 kbps. Ntukeneye indi app yo guhindura. Amabwiriza yuzuye ari mu nyandiko uko wahindura videwo MP3.
